subject.title: refactor: prune unsupported OPENCLAW env overrides

question: May this PR intentionally remove the packaged telemetry override and OpenClaw-prefixed ClawHub credential/config aliases without a compatibility window or migration?
rationale: The patch is mechanically small, but current source names a packaged-launcher contract and the removed credential/settings paths can affect existing upgrades, requiring explicit owner intent.

options.title: Narrow the removal
options.body: Restore `OPENCLAW_TELEMETRY` and any runtime alias lacking shipped-history proof while retaining the clearly internal test-control cleanup.

options.title: Approve the breaking cleanup
options.body: Explicitly accept the runtime compatibility change and require upgrade guidance plus live proof for canonical replacements before merge.

options.title: Pause for contract audit
options.body: Hold the PR until installer, release-tag, and launcher history conclusively classify each runtime override as unshipped and unsupported.

recommendation.title: Narrow the removal
recommendation.body: Restore `OPENCLAW_TELEMETRY` and any runtime alias lacking shipped-history proof while retaining the clearly internal test-control cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: This person sponsored the canonical audit and owns the current implementation, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the compatibility decision.
